title: Payment status (payments.status)
caption: Stripe payments follow the PaymentIntent the worker re-reads (src/payments/payment-state.ts: unconfirmed states take any Stripe state; authorized → captured | canceled only; captured never moves back; canceled and failed are final for Stripe). Airline-card payments are written by the booking orchestrator: processing while the card is sent, captured when the order comes back with every ticket, failed on a decline (the next card is accepted on the same payment). CHECK: refunded ≤ captured ≤ amount.

states.label: requires_payment_method
states.detail: Row inserted by checkout.createPayment; PaymentIntent created with manual capture.

states.label: processing
states.detail: Stripe processing; airline card: the card was sent to Flight Create Orders (brand, BIN, last 4 recorded), outcome unknown or order without every ticket (then ticketing manual_review).

states.label: authorized
states.detail: PaymentIntent `requires_capture`; checkout.complete may run. Watched by payments.authorisation_watch after 5 days.

states.label: captured
states.detail: After the order exists (or staff capture in the console).

states.label: canceled
states.detail: Authorisation voided (`payment.void`: expiry, price change, refusal, not found).

states.label: failed
states.detail: Stripe failure; airline card: declined (`airline.declined`) or refused. An airline-card payment in `failed` takes the traveller's next card on the same paymentId.

transitions.label: airline card: order with every ticket (airline.charged)
airline card: not sent or price changed (card asked again)
